headline: Zadie's, billed as Manchester's first Itameshi (Japanese-Italian) restaurant, opens at Medlock Square in East Manchester.
body: The venue has 258 covers plus 30 counter seats and was developed with Gorgeous Group; the head chef previously worked at Zuma and Lucky Cat. It sits in a £300m hospitality development in East Manchester.
why: Large-format, Japanese-fusion dining is spreading beyond London, here into a large new leisure development rather than a high street.
